Questions?
Read Our FAQs

Do you have references?

Yes, we have many satisfied clients. You can read our reviews here
Do you have experience in our field?

Most of our experience is with global B2B companies in Israel who want to market to the world. We are a team of native English speakers, with experience with creating campaigns in Japanese, French, Chinese, Russian Spanish.... and more. We understand the global market.
You can read our case studies here:
How much do your services cost?

It really depends on your needs. The more you need, the more it will cost. Check out this page for more details.
How much experience do you have?

We started digital marketing in 1998, the infancy of the internet. We celebrate 25 years of digital marketing this year.
Who will be working on my account?
You will work with an experienced digital marketer from our team. We send monthly reports and conduct regular meetings. Weekly, monthly, quarterly. It’s your call.
Can we cancel if we are not satisfied?
Yes, we have a satisfaction guarantee. If you are not satisfied, you can end your contract at the end of the month
Can we hire you for one month and if we don’t see results terminate?

Yes, you can. However, we don’t recommend it.Getting optimal ad copy takes testing. So does zoning in on keywords with the highest ROISEO optimization can take a few months to see results. High tech items often have a long sales cycle as well, so one month definitely won’t be enough.However, we do offer consulting. Let us help you get started or let us audit your current marketing vendors to ensure you are getting the most bang for your buck.
Changing marketing companies is a hassle for us. We would rather keep our same digital marketing vendors. However, we haven’t seen an increase in leads this year. Can you check if our marketing vendors are doing a good job?

Sure. As stated in the previous question, we offer marketing audits. We will audit your ads and your marketing company and give you recommendations to send to them.
